title: Derivatives regime
description: Funding, basis and open interest read together as one state. It is the quickest read on how much leverage sits behind a move.

regime.label: Leverage regime
regime.description: Calm, crowded long, crowded short or stressed, from the three leverage signals combined. Crowded sides are the ones that get flushed.

basis_bps.label: Basis
basis_bps.description: Perp minus spot as a share of price, in basis points, across the venues watched. Positive means leverage is bid.

funding_rate.label: Funding rate
funding_rate.description: The current funding rate across the venues watched. Positive means longs are paying shorts.

open_interest_regime.label: Open interest
open_interest_regime.description: Whether open interest is building, flat or unwinding. Building means new leverage is coming in.
